findings.title: Returned tuple is compared to an int
findings.body: The new `until_service` returns a tuple `(km_left, days_left)` but the planner on line 14 compares it to `SERVICE_WINDOW_KM` (an int) with `>`. This will raise `TypeError` at runtime. Compare against a tuple or unpack the result before comparison.

findings.title: Plate label function is vulnerable to injection
findings.body: `plate_label` directly returns `plate.upper().replace(" ", "")` without sanitizing other special characters. If `plate` contains shell metacharacters or newlines, downstream consumers (e.g., shell commands, logs, or templates) could be exploited. Sanitize the plate string to alphanumeric and spaces only, or escape it contextually.

summary.problem: The service interval function returns a tuple that breaks downstream comparisons, and the plate label function is vulnerable to injection.
summary.done_well: The new function now returns both kilometers and days remaining, improving clarity for callers.
